children: Aptera reported no revenue in the quarter, unchanged year over year, while its net loss widened as research and development spending rose 102%, primarily due to higher engineering, vehicle build, testing and validation costs, and other income shifted to expense from lower grant and interest income and a tooling-disposal loss.

: The company continued validation and durability testing; TÜV Rheinland measured more than 4 kWh of usable solar energy delivered to the battery on each of three test days.
: Aptera issued purchase orders in August for bodies and chassis, including frames and suspension, for initial production vehicles.
: Launch will provide manufacturing, engineering, tooling and testing services under a strategic partnership agreement.
: Aptera estimates approximately $25 million is required to reach start of series production and approximately $65 million in total to reach 500 vehicles per month.
